_comment: Names of the generated vanilla constants that differ from the default (UPPER_SNAKE of the identifier path; PascalCase of the first state name for enums). blocks/items/states: identifier or state name -> constant name. enums: state name -> enum class of its value set. renamed: an identifier Bedrock renamed -> the new one, so the old constant becomes a deprecated alias. fallbacks: what a removed identifier resolves to (default minecraft:unknown). See codegen/README.md.
